name: Creator Studio MCP
description: Creator Studio (YouTube automation) ke local server se baat karta hai — idea bank, 8-stage production pipeline, video records with upload package, brain (research/experiments/findings), skills aur settings. Pehle app me Studio kholo (server start hota hai), phir ye tools chalao.

mcp_tools.name: studio_health
mcp_tools.description: Check karo ki Creator Studio local server chal raha hai. Agar ready:false ya error aaye to owner ko bolo: app me floating switcher se Studio kholein (server wahan se start hota hai).

mcp_tools.name: studio_ideas_list
mcp_tools.description: Idea Bank ke saare ideas (topic, details, status) + unke production runs ki list. Pipeline ka overview lene ke liye.

mcp_tools.name: studio_idea_add
mcp_tools.description: Idea Bank me naya video idea add karo. topic required, details optional (angle, target audience, research notes).

mcp_tools.name: studio_idea_update
mcp_tools.description: Idea edit/update karo — topic, details ya status (new/picked/done).

mcp_tools.name: studio_pipeline_list
mcp_tools.description: Production runs ki detailed list — har run ka current stage, stage statuses, failed stage/reason. Agent ka aage ka plan isi se decide hota hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_pipeline_start
mcp_tools.description: Kisi idea par 8-stage production run START karo (idea status picked ho jata hai). Iske baad stages ke hisaab se kaam karo aur studio_stage_next se advance karo.

mcp_tools.name: studio_stage_next
mcp_tools.description: Active stage ko DONE mark karke agla stage ACTIVE karo (jab current stage ka kaam poora ho jaye). Last stage done hone par run production-ready ho jata hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_run_retry
mcp_tools.description: Failed run ko usi stage par wapas active karke resume karo (fix karne ke baad).

mcp_tools.name: studio_videos_list
mcp_tools.description: Channel ke saare video records — status (processing/uploaded/scheduled/failed), script, pipeline, experiments, upload packaging. Video detail isi se milti hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_video_record
mcp_tools.description: Video record create/update karo (upsert). Fields: title (required), topic, kind (long/short), status (uploaded/scheduled/processing/failed), duration, script, scheduledFor, publishedAt, failReason, progress {stage, pct, note}, packaging {title, description, tags, hashtags, chapters [{time, label}], endScreen, pinnedComment}. Upload package yahin save hota hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_brain_overview
mcp_tools.description: Creator Brain ka full state — research questions, experiments (findings with enabled/disabled report items), tracked videos. Content strategy decisions isi par based karo.

mcp_tools.name: studio_brain_question_add
mcp_tools.description: Naya research question raise karo. areas required (thumbnail/title/topic/hook/seo/length me se), text optional, videoId optional (source video). Same areas wala question repeat hua to wo merge hota hai.

mcp_tools.name: studio_brain_experiment_toggle
mcp_tools.description: Experiment ke report item ko enable/disable karo (body: item_id + enabled) ya poore experiment ke items ek saath set karo (set_all).

mcp_tools.name: studio_dashboard
mcp_tools.description: Home dashboard ka channel health summary (read-only) — overall stats jo Studio ke Home screen par dikhte hain.

mcp_tools.name: studio_settings_get
mcp_tools.description: Studio settings padho — keys MASKED hoti hain (raw token kabhi nahi milti), integrations ka connect status + preferences dikhte hain.

mcp_tools.name: studio_settings_set
mcp_tools.description: Studio settings update karo. Do kind: (1) cred — integrationId + fieldId + value (API key/token save, value null = remove); (2) prefs — preferences patch. Sirf owner ke kehne par ya setup flow me use karo.

mcp_tools.name: studio_skills_list
mcp_tools.description: Installed skill packages ki list — har package ke naam, enabled status, aur skills (name, description, version, stage tags). Kaam shuru se pehle relevant skills dhundo.

mcp_tools.name: studio_skill_get
mcp_tools.description: Ek skill ka poora content padho (skill_id se) — instructions, references, current markdown. Script writing / SEO / thumbnail jaise playbooks isi se follow hote hain.
